hypothesis: A compact zero-shot cross-encoder can improve reciprocal rank within the champion sparse candidate head.

passage_token_audit.truncation_policy: The model truncates only tail fields; title, category, price, store, features, and details are ordered before description.

model_selection_source: Sentence Transformers official pretrained cross-encoder documentation and the official Hugging Face model card
amendment_before_neural_evaluation: The candidate set and actual OOF champion control were frozen after an independent audit and before any cross-encoder candidate completed. Top-50 is fixed at weight 0.25 rather than selected from all-development outcomes.
promotion_rule: Promote only if grouped nested selection beats the stored two-feature linear champion OOF result, MRR gain is stable, and uncached neural runtime and offline asset gates pass.
